entries.zh: 革除、罢黜某人（夺其职）；扣留、把持不放
entries.en: to depose or dismiss a person from office; to detain, withhold

entries.zh: 为民除害；铲除民众祸害
entries.en: to rid the people of harm; to remove scourges from the people

entries.zh: 流徙、流放（被判流放拘禁之人）
entries.en: banishment into exile; a man detained and condemned to exile

entries.zh: 身体寒热失调、冷热不和（失衡致病）
entries.en: distemper of the body; hot and cold out of harmony, bodily indisposition

entries.notes: M 栏一处音节污损难辨（T99）、R 栏有涂改痕迹；释义据西语 Destetar 与汉字“断乳”互证，仍为断奶。
M 栏含 T99 污损并多出难辨词形（svaccer），释义据西语 Destruir 与汉字“灭”。

entries.zh: 剿、剿灭（以火与刀兵扫荡净尽）
entries.en: to exterminate, wipe out (put to fire and sword)
entries.notes: M 栏“灭”字节污损难辨（T99）；释义据汉字“剿”与西语 Destruir a fuego y sangre。

entries.en: to ruin and corrupt, to destroy; to lay waste
entries.notes: M 栏第二变体“败灭”处 T99 污损；“败坏”义有汉字与官话对音互证。

entries.en: to spoil, ruin; a ruined or broken thing
to be defeated; to spoil, decay, be ruined
to destroy, wreck and shatter; to plunder, to rob
entries.notes: M 栏“打却”（音写近“打劫”）与 R 栏对音不对应，释义主要据西语 desbaratar 与汉字“打却”推断。
M 栏“灭”音节污损难辨（T99）；释义据汉字“泯灭”与官话对音。
M 栏“灭”音节污损难辨（T99）；释义据汉字“剿灭”与西语 Destruirlo todo。

entries.en: to storm and breach a city; to take and destroy a city
to break and destroy, to wreck

entries.zh: 破家（倾家荡产；因官司败毁家产）
entries.en: to ruin a household or estate (e.g. through lawsuits)
entries.notes: M 栏“家”音节污损难辨（T99）；释义据西语 Destruir la hacienda con pleitos 与汉字“破家”互证。
